note: The stored queries that GENERATE worker/models.json (src/assist/roster.ts over src/assist/modelSelect.ts). Regenerate with `npm run update:roster`; refresh the catalog snapshot first with `npm run refresh:catalog`. It lives beside its output because the query and the roster are reviewed as one thing.

text.why: The server-key demo roster. BYOK (core-assist-byok.md) spends the user's own key on whatever model they picked, so this allowlist governs only the mode where the deployment's key pays — which is why every query here carries a price ceiling and why none of them opts into `:free` promo endpoints: a committed roster must not name an id that rotates on someone else's promotional schedule.

queries.name: workhorse
queries.why: The default the drawer opens on: tool-calling, a window the document+schema+prompt fits with room to spare, fast enough to watch, and cheap enough to hand a stranger. Speed is weighted level with price here because a demo that stalls reads as broken.

queries.name: capable
queries.why: For the edit the workhorse fumbles. The intelligence floor is the point, so the ceiling rises and the speed floor drops to the slowest a person will sit through; intelligence carries its default weight of 1.5 and duly leads the ranking.

transcribe.why: Declared, not derived — and the exception proves the rule. Transcription models are not chat completions and do not appear in /api/v1/models at all, so there is no catalog row to score and no query that could return one. When a transcription catalog exists these become a lane like any other.
